odd_linear_map.definition: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi[Z_i|Z_j] Z_i, parity-reversing (p(Z_i) != p(Z_j)); phi[K|Z_j] (odd Z_j) is the optional central component

reference_map.description: f_gb = -F, F(X) = kappa-part of X(a',b) - X(a,b) with the odd fermion shift a'^sigma = a^sigma + kappa sum_j (gb_{sigma,j,-} b_j^+ - gb_{sigma,j,+} b_j^-)
